[size=6]Introduce[/size][/b]

[size=3]This mod allows you to open the menu anywhere, including billboards, special orders, shop menus, TV, etc. By pressing a hotkey ([/size][color=#ff0000]default is L[/color][size=3]) in the game, a general menu can be opened, allowing you to select what you want to access from the menu. The mod has certain limitations; for example, if you haven't unlocked Ginger Island, you won't be able to access the menus related to Ginger Island; if you don't have the sewer key, you can't access Krobus's shop, and so on.[/size]
